news.title: Insufficient new directors
news.body: No new directors have joined the board in the last 3 years. The company's board is composed of: No new directors. 3 experienced directors. 3 highly experienced directors. Independent Director Santosh Shah was the last director to join the board, commencing their role in 2023. news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 7.2% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. news.title: First half 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.82 (vs ₹2.20 in 1H 2025)
news.body: First half 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.82 (down from ₹2.20 in 1H 2025). Revenue: ₹142.9m (down 32% from 1H 2025). Net income: ₹17.8m (down 63% from 1H 2025). Profit margin: 13% (down from 23% in 1H 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 15% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 22% per year, which means it is well ahead of earnings.
